description: Breaking the bundle into chunks loaded on demand with dynamic `import()`.
`lazy(() => import('./X'))` returns a component that suspends until the module's default export is loaded. Declare it at module top level.
`<Suspense fallback={...}>` shows the fallback while any child suspends (lazy code, `use(promise)`, Suspense-enabled data libraries).
Calling the same `import()` early (on hover or idle) so the chunk is cached before the lazy component renders.
Catches a rejected lazy import (failed chunk) and renders a recovery UI.
